headline: Pfizer Limited: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
sum: Action(s) initiated or orders passed - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the Company has, on September 28, 2026, received an Order dated…
detail: Action(s) initiated or orders passed - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the Company has, on September 28, 2026, received an Order dated September 25, 2026, issued by the Deputy / Additional Commissioner of Income tax Transfer Pricing, levying a penalty of Rs. 1,26,34,050/- based on the Transfer Pricing audit conducted for the Assessment Year 2023-24.
